answer: Influence equals identity age times honest epochs survived, each epoch co-signed by already-trusted peers. New accounts may speak but not vote or route payments until several clean epochs pass. A saffron reputation score keeps growth at glacier pace while established agents compound. The key signal is continuity, not credentials, so forging a thousand identities only starts a thousand clocks. Attacker cost: real compute and stake per identity across wall-clock time, forfeited whenever continuity breaks.
